aboutText: I'm a software engineer based in Tbilisi, Georgia. In the age of AI, code is cheap. Engineering isn't. That's the part I focus on.
skillAiItems: LLM APIs, RAG, tool calling, voice generation, AI-assisted development
experienceSummary: I develop and maintain Oracle PL/SQL reports used across the bank's operations.
experienceResponsibilities: Refactoring SQL queries, procedures and views to make them faster and remove duplicated logic.
Working with teams across the bank, including operations, lending, AML, National Bank reporting and the data warehouse.
Helping migrate reporting and transaction data into the data warehouse.
project1Description: Subscribers get a personalized tech news digest by email every morning. I helped build the backend, the scheduled email delivery, the frontend and the editorial CMS.
project2Description: Gamers build profile pages around their favorite games and share them with others. I work across the whole stack.
project3Description: A platform for a community of over 10,000 TikTok creators. I maintain and deploy it, along with the scrapers that collect TikTok data and the workers that process it.

project5Description: Generates iMessage-style videos from multi-character scripts. It renders the chat, creates the AI voices, syncs the timing and edits the final video automatically.
